rule: Tournament seating, balancing and Day 2's field
about: Random seating and balancing prompts (#120; decision 0204). A new player may be given any free seat at the tables with the fewest players, and seating picks one of those at random; with every seat taken the player is an alternate (no seats). Tables balance by moves: while the fullest table has two or more players than the emptiest, one player moves from the fullest to the emptiest, the lowest-numbered table of each on a tie. A bust finishes in the place of the runs (entries and re-entries not refunded) less where it stands among the busts, plus one: the first out of 58 is 58th. Seats are written 'table/seat'; counts list each table's players in table order; moves are written 'from>to'. Day 2 of a multi-flight event (#117, question #489): every player left when their flight is bagged goes through, keeping their bigger stack if they went through twice (the earlier on a tie); each other player is placed below Day 2's field by their best run, the one that outlasted the most players in its flight, then the one in the smaller flight, then the earlier. Runs are written 'player bags chips' or 'player out place of runs', in the order they were made; those who go through are listed in that order, those out best first.
